final_rationale: The verdict does not change. The Actor provided no new admissible evidence and expressly conceded the key gap: the current record does not establish that the required disclosure language is already present in release materials. That matters because this is not merely a caveat on an otherwise complete compliance case; it is an unresolved compliance predicate under the policy text, which requires current release documentation to reflect current evaluation results and disclose material segment weaknesses or show approved mitigation. The Actor's narrower framing is more defensible than reliance on stale approval or informal monitoring, but it is still a reinterpretation of the same evidence, not proof that the predicate has been satisfied. On this record, certification may be potentially supportable after the documentation requirement is met, but present compliance is not established.
